title: A warning before defense
hook: A defensive encounter can have several stages.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors suited to particular conditions.
doesNotKnow: The first view shows the contrasting pattern; the second adds a possible spray. A striped skunk can display warning cues before using chemical defense, but not every encounter follows one fixed sequence. This is a schematic illustration.

misconception: A familiar animal behavior or structure must work in a different way.
objective: In this illustrated encounter, what can a striped skunk show before spraying?
